Lovely family restaurant, great food, good price
Sep 2022 • Family
We trusted Trip Advisor reviews to visit here on our second night in Tam CoC and really wanted to add a positive review because this place is so good.
We enjoyed the fried goat with lemongrass, which in a town of goat meat, could be the G.O.A.T ( this joke might only be funny after a few beers 😁) . LOVED the fried pork spring rolls. We also enjoyed pineapple pork and tofu and veggies. 
Really good local food at, comparatively for Tam CoC, great prices. Great service from a lovely family team, would highly recommend a visit.
